steps.en: Copy reviewed core and effect modules into the game
steps.zh: 把审过的核心和特效模块复制进游戏

steps.en: Create a frame and an effect instance
Update, clear and draw in your game loop
steps.zh: 在自己的游戏循环内更新、清空和绘制

steps.en: Draw color and light buffers, then composite RGBA pixels
steps.zh: 绘制颜色和发光缓冲，再合成 RGBA 像素

steps.en: For another engine, request a fixed sprite sheet
steps.zh: 其他引擎则请求固定精灵图集

steps.en: Write the PNG grid and frame timing JSON
steps.zh: 写出 PNG 网格和帧时序 JSON

value.en: Reuse parameterized effect recipes live or as baked assets without repainting every variant
value.zh: 把参数化特效配方实时复用或烘焙成资产，不必重画每种变化
